column8: Revision-240 mutable three-component float vector: constructors, set/add/subtract/cross/dot/length/normalize bodies all agree on one x/y/z tuple; projectile target resolution consumes it as scene-space x/height/z
First constructor component; classNG.method7883 stores resolved horizontal x here and Projectile.method1228 reads it as the first horizontal trajectory coordinate
Second constructor component; classNG.method7883 stores resolved terrain/entity height here and Projectile.method1228 uses it as the vertical trajectory coordinate
Third constructor component; classNG.method7883 stores resolved horizontal world/scene y here and Projectile.method1228 reads it as the second horizontal trajectory coordinate
Writes all three vector components directly; multiple copy/cross/transform helpers delegate to this canonical setter
Computes reciprocal length and scales x/y/z by it
Replaces this vector with the three-component cross product against the supplied vector
Multiplies all components by one scalar
Tests each component within +/- 9.765625E-4, preserving the stock epsilon
Returns this vector to the bounded static pool when capacity remains; Projectile/classNG release temporary resolved positions through this path
